files.test_impl.py:
import pytest
from impl import run

INV = [
 {'invoice_number': 'FV20260301', 'customer': 'A', 'due_date': '2026-07-31', 'amount_czk': 100.0},
 {'invoice_number': 'FV20260302', 'customer': 'B', 'due_date': '2026-08-04', 'amount_czk': 200.0},
 {'invoice_number': 'FV20260303', 'customer': 'A', 'due_date': '2026-12-01', 'amount_czk': 50.0},
]
TX = [{'date': '2026-08-02', 'amount': 100.0, 'variable_symbol': '20260301', 'message': ''}]


def test_basic():
    r = run({'customer_invoices': INV, 'bank_transactions': TX, 'as_of_date': '2026-10-09'})
    assert len(r['overdue']) == 1
    assert r['overdue'][0]['invoice_number'] == 'FV20260302'
    assert r['overdue'][0]['days_late'] == 66
    assert r['total_overdue_czk'] == 200.0


def test_partial_and_filter():
    tx = [{'date': '2026-08-02', 'amount': 80.0, 'variable_symbol': '', 'message': 'Uhrada FV20260302'}]
    r = run({'customer_invoices': INV, 'bank_transactions': tx, 'as_of_date': '2026-10-09', 'customer_filter': 'b'})
    assert [o['outstanding_czk'] for o in r['overdue']] == [120.0]


def test_bad():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'customer_invoices': 'x', 'bank_transactions': []})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'customer_invoices': [], 'bank_transactions': [], 'as_of_date': 'nonsense'})
